study.question: Does the observed match-action summary advantage survive when BOTH observed and item-duplicate selected input derivatives are stopped, and does that conditional content effect interact with task-specific versus shared residual readout? This attributes a component of historical-feedback utility; it does not measure total action removal or all task conditioning.
study.hypothesis: Observation: the source incumbent click AUC is 0.6667535475 versus DIN 0.6555440824. Complete token erasure yielded 0.6411900073/task and 0.6407085599/shared; the context replacement was 0.6414296870, so zeroing alone was not a capacity-matched explanation. Scorer-only action r0025 was 0.6541741279 while value-only was 0.6662444305/task and 0.6647487996/shared. Separate pooling and summaries underperformed their combination (r0026); summary rotation reduced task AUC from 0.6662444305 to 0.6631998063 (r0029), making action/context alignment a concrete limitation. Matched item replacement r0034 gave 0.6637250089/task and 0.6616944666/shared, below observed 0.6662444305 and 0.6647487996 by 0.0025194215 and 0.0030543330. Mixed raw/scaled replacements r0035 largely retained utility, with task AUCs 0.6658683269/0.6658657279; this does not uniquely identify either row. Most recently, stopping the duplicate-to-item derivative r0036 changed AUC only -0.0001014115/task and +0.0000403004/shared relative to attached duplicate; the attempted recovery was negative and the content gap persists descriptively. All are one frozen seed, not independent replications; recorded candidate diagnostics are not_requested. Mechanism hypothesis: at least part of the match-action benefit is useful forward content available to the residual readout, rather than the selected match-action-to-embedding gradient or the extra duplicate-to-item gradient. Stopping both selected input derivatives should therefore leave an observed-over-duplicate gap within each routing mode. This is provisional, conditional support: surviving gaps can still reflect scale, information rank or optimization through other consumers.

The four submitted cells cross observed versus item_duplicate with task versus shared residual routing; BOTH selected observed and duplicate input gradients are blocked. Duplicate controls are deliberate same-seed source bridges to r0036, not repetitions. Observed/attached is a diagnostic configuration and historical comparison, not a fifth trained variant. Primary content effects are C_t=O_t-D_t and C_s=O_s-D_s. Directional prediction: both positive. Predeclared practical strong-retention criterion: both exceed 0.001 absolute AUC; a smaller positive gap is weak descriptive support, not significance.

At common state, observed blocked versus its attached diagnostic endpoint has identical predictions and Dice updates, while only selected summary-to-action-input Jacobians change. This operational threshold is not an uncertainty interval.

The predeclared interaction is I=(O_t-D_t)-(O_s-D_s). Compare its sign/magnitude with historical attached-content I=-0.0005349114410193; no direction is predicted, and no causal interaction or significance is established from this one seed.

falsifiers: C_t or C_s at or below zero weakens forward-content utility in that routing; near zero does not refute all historical feedback because direct pool, ordinal action and supplied feedback masks remain present.
A material observed-stop loss relative to the historical attached endpoint weakens the claim that its selected embedding-gradient contribution is unnecessary, even if observed still beats duplicate.

A content gap that vanishes with legal repeated seeds, user-cluster uncertainty, or a later independently predeclared scale control weakens the forward-information account; deterministic same-seed bridges do not count as repeated support.

alternative_explanations: Action and item-derived summaries can have different variance, covariance, rank and conditioning; stopping their local derivatives matches neither forward distribution nor effective information rank.

Action embeddings continue learning through direct pools and ordinal summaries, and item embeddings through ordinary item paths. Content remains an intervention on the full training trajectory, not a frozen universal information-value estimate.

Task/shared uses the same number of instantiated/executed adapters, but shared bank-mean routing changes effective capacity, gradient sharing and optimization geometry. Its interaction is conditional on this parameterization, not all task conditioning.
The task-mask-derived auxiliary union still carries historical action information even when a token path is removed; these are component controls, not a global no-feedback model.

Single-seed selection over many adaptive rounds, finite-precision effects and inherited batch normalization can explain small differences. All available indexed trajectories succeeded; failed scientific predictions such as duplicate-gradient recovery remain recorded, but no nonexistent execution failures are fabricated.

Official offline delayed feedback and static benchmark snapshots do not establish production point-in-time availability. Auxiliary cart/fav/buy labels match user/category/brand within 24h, not advertisement-specific conversions.
